concave_primary_mirror.name: Concave Primary Mirror (Reflector)
concave_primary_mirror.description: Large curved mirror at the base of a reflecting telescope that reflects and converges incoming parallel starlight toward a focal point with zero chromatic aberration.

flat_secondary_mirror.name: Flat Secondary Diagonal Mirror
flat_secondary_mirror.description: Small flat mirror angled at 45 degrees near the open aperture that deflects the converging light cone 90 degrees out through the side of the tube into the eyepiece.

reflector_eyepiece.name: Eyepiece Lens (Reflector)
reflector_eyepiece.description: Short focal length magnifying lens positioned at the side of the telescope tube that produces a magnified virtual image for the observer or detector.

objective_lens.name: Convex Objective Lens (Refractor)
objective_lens.description: Large double-convex glass lens at the front aperture of a refracting telescope that bends (refracts) incoming starlight rays to form an inverted real intermediate image.

refractor_eyepiece.name: Eyepiece Lens (Refractor)
refractor_eyepiece.description: Convex lens at the rear of the refracting tube that magnifies the real intermediate image produced by the objective lens.

focal_point.name: Principal Focal Point (F)
focal_point.description: Point along the principal optical axis where parallel light rays refracted by the objective lens intersect and form a real inverted image.
